parrafo.es: Clean Machine Mobile Detailing lleva un detallado completo hasta tu entrada en San Petersburgo. Limpieza profunda de interior, eliminacion de olores y un acabado a mano que dura, muchas veces el mismo dia que llamas.

parrafo_1.es: Clean Machine Mobile Detailing es un equipo de detallado movil con base en San Petersburgo. Llevan el equipo hasta donde estes, ya sea un auto del dia a dia, un clasico o una camioneta levantada, y trabajan interior y exterior hasta que quede como debe.
parrafo_1.en: Clean Machine Mobile Detailing is a mobile detailing crew based in St. Petersburg. They bring the full setup to you, whether it is a daily driver, a classic or a lifted truck, and work through interior and exterior until it looks right.

parrafo_2.es: Sus resenas cuentan lo mismo una y otra vez: respuesta rapida, muchas veces el mismo dia, y un resultado que dura. Olores persistentes eliminados, alfombras y asientos restaurados, sin saltarse los rincones cerca de la consola.
parrafo_2.en: Their reviews describe the same thing over and over: fast response, often same-day, and a result that holds up. Lingering odors gone, carpets and seats restored, and the small areas around the console never skipped.

items.quote: BEST DETAIL IN ST. PETE AREA! Tim did an amazing job with my car detail! Successfully got rid of a lingering vomit smell and restored the interior to brand new. Very affordable, timely, and reasonably priced. Came the same day we called! Will definitely be getting more services from them in the future.

Clean Machine Mobile Detailing did a great job getting my car back into shape after months of everyday use. The interior looked fresh, the seats and carpets came out much cleaner, and they didn't skip the small areas around the console.
Needed to have my car detailed at the last minute and Tim came through the very same day. Absolutely the cleanest my car has ever been since the day I bought it. Outstanding job!
